li.label: shared something
li.description: We were there together for it, and it was good to have them beside me.

li.label: argued over a sign
li.description: We saw the same thing and could not agree on what it meant, and it turned into an argument.

li.label: made it up
li.description: We were at odds, and now we aren't. I'm glad of it.

li.label: looked out for me
li.description: They went out of their way for me when they didn't have to. I won't forget it.

li.label: resentful
li.description: Everyone made a fuss over them, and I know my work is as good.

li.label: uneasy about them
li.description: I saw something I didn't like, and I can't look at them the same way now.

li.label: laughed at me
li.description: They laughed at me in front of everyone. It still stings.

li.label: ashamed
li.description: It was shown to me in front of someone else, and they were right.

li.label: proud of it
li.description: I did that, and everyone saw it.

plain.li: [hollinbound_believe] Two of them, side by side, right where we argued.
[hollinbound_believe] She put these here for us, {OTHER}, I'm sure of it.
[hollinbound_believe,named] {GOD} doesn't like a quarrel on her ground, and neither do I.
[hollinbound_plain] Two saplings overnight, and both of us standing here like fools.
[hollinbound_plain] All right, {OTHER}, I'm sorry about yesterday.
[hollinbound_doubt] Two weeds came up and now we're meant to hug, are we.
[hollinbound_doubt] Somebody planted these to make a point, and it wasn't a god.
[hollinstumps_show] Look at your stump, {OTHER}, the brambles came up round it overnight.
[hollinstumps_show] That's how many trees now, {OTHER}, and how many have you planted?
[hollinstumps_show,named] {GOD} remembers every one of them, {OTHER}.
[hollinstumps_ashamed] I didn't think of it that way, I only cut what we needed.
[hollinstumps_ashamed] I'll plant some back, I promise.
[hollinstumps_doubt] Brambles grow on stumps, that's what they do.
[hollinstumps_doubt] We need the wood, and no bush is going to tell me otherwise.
[smoulderpraise_proud] Look at that, the best thing I've ever made.
[smoulderpraise_proud] Did you see the forge flare when I finished it?
[smoulderpraise_proud,named] That one's good enough for {GOD} himself.
[smoulderpraise_envy] It's good work, I suppose, if you like that sort of thing.
[smoulderpraise_envy] I could have made that, {OTHER}, if anyone had given me the time.
[smoulderpraise_envy] Everyone fussing over one piece, honestly.
[smouldernearmiss_pull] Get back, {OTHER}, the rock's moving.
[smouldernearmiss_pull] Move, {OTHER}, now.
[smouldernearmiss_thanks] That would have been on my head, {OTHER}, thank you.
[smouldernearmiss_thanks] You pulled me out of the way, I owe you.
[smouldernearmiss_thanks] The mountain turned over in its sleep, and you were quicker.
[smouldernearmiss_thanks,named] {GOD} shifted down there, and you saved me from it.
[smouldernearmiss_doubt] Loose rock, we should have shored it, but thank you, {OTHER}.
[bellwethertold_tell] There's a great white beast that walks the world, and he likes children.
[bellwethertold_tell] Sit still and watch, they come closer if you're quiet.
[bellwethertold_tell,named] When I was your age my grandmother told me about {GOD}.
[bellwethertold_child] They came right up to us, did you see?
[bellwethertold_child] Will the white one come one day, do you think?
[bellwethertold_child] Tell me the part about the horn again.
[bellwetherspared_let] It looked right at me, I couldn't do it.
[bellwetherspared_let] Go on, then, off with you.
[bellwetherspared_let,named] Not this one, {GOD} can have it.
[bellwetherspared_praise] I heard you let the {BEAST} go, {OTHER}, and you did right.
[bellwetherspared_praise] Some beasts are meant to be let pass, {OTHER}.
[bellwetherspared_praise,named] {GOD} saw that, {OTHER}, I'm sure of it.
[bellwetherspared_grumble] You had a {BEAST} in your sights and you let it walk off, {OTHER}?
[bellwetherspared_grumble] There went a week of meat, {OTHER}.
[bellwetherspared_answer] It looked at me, and I wasn't going to shoot it after that.
[bellwetherspared_answer] We have enough, we don't need every beast that walks past.
[morelwasted_whose] Who left the {THING} out here to rot, {OTHER}?
[morelwasted_whose] This {THING} was good yesterday, whose job was it?
[morelwasted_give] Give it back to her, {OTHER}, it's no good to us now.
[morelwasted_give,named] {GOD} takes what we let go, let's dig it in for her.
[morelwasted_agree] Fine, out to the field with it, it'll feed something.
[morelwasted_agree] At least the soil will have it.
[morelwasted_blame] Don't look at me, I wasn't the one who left it.
[morelwasted_blame] It was on the cook's list, not mine, {OTHER}.
[morelwasted_doubt] It rotted because it was left out, nobody's mother took it.
[morelsealed_kept] Look at the threads, she wants {DEAD} back in the earth.
[morelsealed_kept] We shut {DEAD} away in stone, and now look at it.
[morelsealed_kept,named] {GOD} doesn't like to have the dead kept from her.
[morelsealed_whole] {DEAD} is kept whole in there, as the dead should be.
[morelsealed_whole] Leave the stone alone, it's the right way to keep them.
[morelsealed_doubt] It's mould, {OTHER}, it grows on damp stone.
[morelsealed_doubt] Scrub it off and stop frightening everyone.
[ennuwelcomed_bowl] Here, {OTHER}, you'll want something warm after the road.
[ennuwelcomed_bowl] Sit and eat, nobody new goes hungry here.
[ennuwelcomed_bowl,named] {GOD} would want you fed first, so here you are.
[ennuwelcomed_welcome] Welcome, {OTHER}, sit with me a while.
[ennuwelcomed_welcome] Come and sit, you can learn everyone's names later.
[ennuwelcomed_thanks] Thank you, {OTHER}, that's more than I expected.
[ennuwelcomed_thanks] You're the first to sit with me since I came.
[ennuwelcomed_chide] {NEWCOMER} is one of us now, {OTHER}, so act like it.
[ennuwelcomed_chide] A stranger is a guest until they're family, {OTHER}.
[ennuwaitedup_waited] There you are, {OTHER}, I kept a light for you.
[ennuwaitedup_waited] I wasn't going to bed until you were back.
[ennuwaitedup_waited,named] {GOD} keeps a place for whoever's late, so I did too.
[ennuwaitedup_late] You waited up for me, {OTHER}?
[ennuwaitedup_late] I saw the light from out there and knew it was you.
[piptwohands_hands] Put your hand on it with mine, {OTHER}, just try.
[piptwohands_hands] It wanted the both of us, listen to it hum.
[piptwohands_hands,named] {GOD} was waiting for someone to come and see it.
[piptwohands_believe] It hummed the moment we both touched it, {OTHER}.
[piptwohands_believe] It only needed company.
[piptwohands_plain] Well, it's running, and I don't know why.
[piptwohands_plain] I'll take it, whatever that was.
[piptwohands_doubt] A loose wire settled when we leaned on it, that's all.
[piptwohands_doubt] Machines don't get lonely, {OTHER}.
[piptalked_talk] Come on, then, you can do it, I know you can.
[piptalked_talk] There we are, good, that's better.
[piptalked_talk,named] I'll tell {GOD} how well you did today.
[piptalked_mock] You're talking to the {MACHINE}, {OTHER}?
[piptalked_mock] Does it talk back, {OTHER}?
[piptalked_hum] Hear that, {OTHER}, it likes being talked to.
[piptalked_hum] Laugh all you like, it never hums for you.
[cirrustwowatchers_see] Look up, {OTHER}, quick, there.
[cirrustwowatchers_see] Did you see that one cross the whole sky?
[cirrustwowatchers_see,named] {GOD} is watching tonight, look.
[cirrustwowatchers_wish] I made a wish on it, I won't tell you what.
[cirrustwowatchers_wish] I'm glad I was out here to see it with you, {OTHER}.
[cirrustwowatchers_wish] Let's stay out a little longer in case there's another.
[cirruscloudshape_shape] That cloud is {THEIRS}, look, plain as anything.
[cirruscloudshape_shape] There, {OTHER}, that one is {THEIRS}, you can see the shape.
[cirruscloudshape_shapeplain] That cloud looks like a great beast lying down.
[cirruscloudshape_same] It is {THEIRS}, I see it too.
[cirruscloudshape_same] You're right, {OTHER}, I'd know that shape anywhere.
[cirruscloudshape_other] That's not it at all, that's {THEIRS} up there.
[cirruscloudshape_other] You only see what you want to, it's {THEIRS} and you know it.
[cirruscloudshape_plain] I see a beast, or maybe a boat.
[cirruscloudshape_doubt] It's a cloud, {OTHER}, it's a cloud.
[cirruscloudshape_doubt] And that one over there looks like soup.
[hushcoat_give] Put this on, {OTHER}, you're blue with cold.
[hushcoat_give] Here, the {COAT} is warmer than what you've got.
[hushcoat_give,named] {GOD} doesn't want the weak left out in it, so wear this.
[hushcoat_thanks] Thank you, {OTHER}, I couldn't feel my hands.
[hushcoat_thanks] I didn't even notice how cold I'd got.
[hushnoise_quiet] Keep it down, {OTHER}, it's a cold night and people are sleeping.
[hushnoise_quiet] Not tonight, {OTHER}, please, let it be quiet.
[hushnoise_quiet,named] {GOD} walks on nights like this, and she hates the noise.
[hushnoise_sorry] You're right, I'm sorry, we'll stop.
[hushnoise_sorry] I forgot what night it was, sorry.
[hushnoise_grumble] Fine, fine, we're stopping.
[hushnoise_grumble] All right, but you're no fun, {OTHER}.
[hushnoise_refuse] It's my evening too, {OTHER}, go to bed if you want quiet.
[hushnoise_refuse] I'm not stopping for a ghost story.
[undertowwhisper_saw] What is {WHISPERER} doing out there in the dark?
[undertowwhisper_saw] Who's {WHISPERER} talking to out there?
[undertowwhisper_saw] I didn't like the sound of that at all.
[undertowwhisper_caught] I was only getting some air, {OTHER}.
[undertowwhisper_caught] Mind your own business, {OTHER}.
[undertowlampout_who] Who let the {LIGHT} go out last night, {OTHER}?
[undertowlampout_who] I woke up in the pitch dark, whose job was the {LIGHT}?
[undertowlampout_notme] Don't look at me, I filled it yesterday.
[undertowlampout_notme] It was full when I went to bed, {OTHER}.
[undertowlampout_laugh] We'll both fill it tonight, then, and stop blaming each other.
[heliossun_come] Come and sit in the sun with me a while, {OTHER}.
[heliossun_come] You've been inside too long, the sun will do you good.
[heliossun_come,named] {GOD} gives it for nothing, so come and have some.
[heliossun_warm] That's better, I can feel it on my face.
[heliossun_warm] I'd forgotten how good it is to sit out in the light.
[heliosalike_alike] The sun's on both of you the same, so maybe stop scowling.
[heliosalike_alike] He gives to everyone alike, {OTHER}, you two could try it.
[heliosalike_alike,named] {GOD} doesn't pick sides, so why should we?
[heliosalike_agree] Fair enough, it's too nice a day to stay angry.
[heliosalike_agree] All right, {OTHER}, I'll let it go if you will.
[heliosalike_doubt] The sun's hot, that's all, and I'm still not talking to them.
[heliosshade_shade] Come out of the sun, {OTHER}, before it cooks you.
[heliosshade_shade] That's enough for now, come and sit in the shade with me.
[heliosshade_sun] He doesn't mean to burn anyone, he just gives too much.
[heliosshade_sun,named] {GOD} is giving more than we can take today.
[heliosshade_thanks] Thanks, {OTHER}, I didn't notice how hot it got.
[heliosshade_thanks] I needed that, I was starting to see spots.
[selenesorry_sorry] I couldn't sleep last night for what I said to you, {OTHER}.
[selenesorry_sorry] I was out under the moon half the night, and I'm sorry, {OTHER}.
[selenesorry_sorry,named] {GOD} gave it back to me all night, and I deserved it.
[selenesorry_accept] All right, {OTHER}, I'll let it go.
[selenesorry_accept] Thank you for saying it.
[selenesorry_refuse] A sorry doesn't take it back, {OTHER}.
[selenesorry_refuse] Save it, I'm not ready to hear it.
[selenesamedream_dream] I dreamt I was standing in water under a white moon.
[selenesamedream_dream] I dreamt of a long road with a silver light at the end of it.
[selenesamedream_same] So did I, {OTHER}, exactly that.
[selenesamedream_same] That was my dream too, word for word.
[selenesamedream_uneasy] That's what I dreamt, and I don't like that you did too.
[selenesamedream_uneasy] Why were you in my dream, {OTHER}?
[moggravecat_cat] Look, the cat's sitting with {DEAD}.
[moggravecat_cat] It came by itself, {OTHER}, and just sat down there.
[moggravecat_cat,named] {GOD} sent one to keep {DEAD} company.
[moggravecat_remember] I still go to say something to {DEAD} and remember.
[moggravecat_remember] Sit with me a while, {OTHER}.
[mogriddle_ask] What has a door and no house, {OTHER}?
[mogriddle_ask] What walks all night and never moves from the doorway?
[mogriddle_ask] I've got one you won't get, {OTHER}.
[mogriddle_stumped] Fine, you win, tell me the answer.
[mogriddle_stumped] I give up, {OTHER}, I've got nothing.
[murmursplash_splash] That's for yesterday, {OTHER}.
[murmursplash_splash] You looked like you needed cooling off.
[murmursplash_splash,named] {GOD} says hello, {OTHER}.
[murmursplash_back] Oh, now you're going to get it.
[murmursplash_back] Two can play that game, {OTHER}.
[murmursplash_offended] I'm soaked, {OTHER}, that's not funny.
[murmursplash_offended] Very clever, now I have to change.
[murmurfrogin_keep] Leave it be, {OTHER}, it came in out of the rain.
[murmurfrogin_keep,named] That's one of {GOD}'s, don't you dare hurt it.
[murmurfrogin_out] There's a frog on my floor, {OTHER}, get it out.
[murmurfrogin_out] I'm not sleeping with that thing in here.
[murmurfrogin_agree] Come on then, out you go, back to the wet.
[murmurfrogin_agree] Look at its face, {OTHER}, it's as surprised as we are.
[ducatpassed_found] A gold coin, just lying here.
[ducatpassed_found] Somebody dropped this, or nobody did.
[ducatpassed_give] Here, {OTHER}, I think this is meant for you.
[ducatpassed_give] It didn't feel right to keep it, take it.
[ducatpassed_give,named] {GOD} never stays put, so I'm passing it on.
[ducatpassed_thanks] For me, {OTHER}, really?
[ducatpassed_thanks] That's kind, I won't forget it.
[ducatpassed_stores] It goes in the stores, it was never mine to keep.
[ducatmiser_laugh] Up all night counting it, {OTHER}, and look where it ended up.
[ducatmiser_laugh] The silver ran away from you, {OTHER}.
[ducatmiser_believe] Gold doesn't sit still for anyone, {OTHER}, let it go.
[ducatmiser_believe,named] {GOD} doesn't like a miser, everyone knows that.
[ducatmiser_ashamed] I was only checking it was all there.
[ducatmiser_ashamed] Fine, I'll leave it alone.
[ducatmiser_angry] Somebody moved it to make a fool of me.
[revelrivalscup_pour] Here, {OTHER}, one {DRINK}, and let's leave it there.
[revelrivalscup_pour] I'm not saying I was wrong, but drink this.
[revelrivalscup_pour,named] {GOD} says a shared cup ends a quarrel, so here.
[revelrivalscup_drink] All right, {OTHER}, to us, then.
[revelrivalscup_drink] Fine, but you're pouring the next one.
[revelrivalscup_refuse] I don't drink, {OTHER}, but thanks for the thought.
[revelrivalscup_refuse] Not tonight, I'll keep my head clear.
[revelwager_wager] I bet you I can, {OTHER}, loser scrubs the other's floor.
[revelwager_wager] Want a bet on it, {OTHER}?
[revelwager_taken] You're on, and you'll be scrubbing.
[revelwager_taken] Done, shake on it.
[revelwager_scrub] A bet's a bet, {OTHER}, but I'm never drinking with you again.
[revelwager_scrub] I don't even remember what the bet was.
